### ⭐ The methodological half is the more valuable one, and it is why two of these were invisible

The card records that the census on record declared its unit as *"one LINE"*, while all three carriers of objectui#7448's pin actually run the pattern over the **joined** text (`split` / `filter` / `map` / `join`, then `matchAll` over the join) — so `\s+` in the family pattern spans a line break. ⇒ under the carriers' own unit these sentences are readable; under a per-line unit they are not. **Two of the three were missed for that reason alone, not because they were new prose.**

⚠️ That is the same wrapped-line subtlety objectui#8606 hit from the workflow side. Read both before choosing a unit; ⛔ do not fix #8606's header here and ⛔ do not fix these counts there. Two cards, one lesson, separate file surfaces.

### Scope note carried forward from the filing seat

The card was filed rather than fixed because objectui#7966's declared file surface was `scripts/**` with `content/docs/**` **read-only** — the fence held, correctly. ⇒ this card is where the `content/docs/**` edit is allowed to happen.

⛔ Prefer establishing a measurement point over hand-correcting a number: a corrected count with nothing checking it is the same card again in a month.

`Size/model suggestion:` M — three counts, but the unit decision is shared with #8606 and is the real work.

## Fold-or-serial — answered explicitly, ⛔ not by default

**Three cards share `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`: this one, objectui#8726 and objectui#8420. SERIAL, all three. ⛔ Not folded.**

The folding test is *same defect shape and same fix*, and ⛔ explicitly **not** same keyword or same subsystem — one page is a subsystem. Measured against that:

| card | defect | fix lands in |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **this one** | live counts stated with **no measurement point** | the guide's prose |
| objectui#8726 | the inventory **table** is unpinned — the pin reads only headings | the doc-parity test |
| objectui#8420 | sections are unpinned against **what their jobs run** | per-section pins, by the card's own words needing per-section judgement |

⇒ three defects, three fixes, one page. **Order: this card → objectui#8726 → objectui#8420**, by card order (this and #8726 are Bugs, #8420 a Task; ties by age). Whichever goes next merges `main` first.

⚠️ **The page is hot in the literal sense too:** five commits touched it today alone. Merge `main` immediately before you open the pull request.

## The ruling — quoted, ⛔ not paraphrased

From triage comment 5619203600:

> ⛔ Prefer establishing a measurement point over hand-correcting a number: a corrected count with nothing checking it is the same card again in a month.

> ⚠️ That is the same wrapped-line subtlety objectui#8606 hit from the workflow side. Read both before choosing a unit; ⛔ do not fix #8606's header here and ⛔ do not fix these counts there. Two cards, one lesson, separate file surfaces.

> The card was filed rather than fixed because objectui#7966's declared file surface was `scripts/**` with `content/docs/**` **read-only** — the fence held, correctly. ⇒ this card is where the `content/docs/**` edit is allowed to happen.

## ⭐ A premise the ruling could not have — the sibling's answer LANDED after it was written

That ruling was written at 13:09Z and names objectui#8606 as the card sharing this decision. **objectui#8606 landed at 16:47:32Z today** (`e8b7b0785`). ⇒ its answer is on `main` now and is the established precedent for this exact question — ⭐ **read it before choosing your shape.** What it did, in one line: it deleted the stated population count, said in the header *why* no count is stated there, and pointed at the directory the population is derived from on every run. ⛔ It did not correct the number.

⇒ that is the ruling's 「establish a measurement point」 with a worked example in the tree. ⛔ You are not bound to copy it — the surfaces differ, a workflow header versus a published guide — but if you depart from it, say why in the pull request body.

## ⭐ The methodological trap — this seat walked into it 20 minutes ago

The card's own central point: the census that missed two of these declared its unit as **one line**, while the pin family's carriers run their pattern over the **joined** text, so whitespace in the pattern spans a line break.

⭐ **This is not theoretical. Verifying this card's premises, this seat grepped both sentences and got ZERO for each**, and the file was fine — a firing control on the same file returned 174 hits. Both sentences simply **wrap**: the number sits at the end of one line and its noun at the start of the next. ⇒ ⛔ **any per-line reader you build, or use to check your own work, will tell you these defects do not exist.** Read joined text, and prove your reader fires on a known-present wrapped sentence before you trust a zero from it.

## Premises — READ on `origin/main` = `9b83f4796`, tip committed 2026-09-10T16:34:38Z, at 16:55Z

1. Both live counts are still present and still wrapped: the docs-page population inside the sentence about the catalog-blocks side-effect import list, and the file count inside the sentence about the `skills` row's collapse detector.
2. ⭐ **The docs-page count is measurably wrong today.** The corpus is **184** git-tracked `.md`/`.mdx` files under the directory the site's source config declares (`dir: '../../content/docs'`), against **181** claimed. ⛔ Re-measure before you write anything — that reading is minutes old and the page moves hourly.
3. The third member (the sweeper's upstream default page window) was **true** when filed and the card recorded it deliberately last, as a copied constant with no measurement point.
4. ⚠️ The third member's membership is **not yours to settle**: the card says a `pages?` noun matching *paginated API result pages* may leave the class entirely, and that ruling belongs to objectui#7966, which is open. ⇒ ⛔ do not resolve that question here; handle the member in a way that survives either answer, or leave it and say so.

## ⛔ The exclusion list — four sentences on this page that are NOT defects

The card names four more matched sentences that are **correct because each declares the tree or window it measured**, and ⭐ warns that rewriting any of them into a live figure would *create* the defect. All four have already drifted in their numbers and are still true. They are, by content: the skills-paths guide-file measurement stated against a named commit; the test-file/test-count cell stated against a named commit — ⭐ itself the remedy from an earlier card working, having already survived one drift; the first-parent-commit window on changeset overwrites; and a fields-page figure.

⛔ **Do not touch any of the four.** ⚠️ If your reader flags them, your reader is wrong, ⛔ not the sentences.

## ⛔ Boundaries

- ⛔ Never fix objectui#8606's workflow header here — it is landed and it is a different file surface.
- ⛔ Never touch the doc-parity test's inventory or command-parity assertions; those are objectui#8726's and objectui#8420's, both behind this card in the serial queue.
- ⛔ Never correct a number and stop. A corrected count with nothing checking it is this card again in a month, in the ruling's own words.
- ⛔ Never skip, disable or quarantine a test. ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`.

## Mechanics

- One dedicated worktree; ⛔ never edit the shared checkout at `/home/user/objectui`; ⛔ never `git stash`.
- Branch `claude/issue-8629-doc-count-measurement-points`; `Fixes objectui#8629`.
- ⚠️ Merge `origin/main` immediately before opening the pull request — five commits touched this page today.
- Changeset per the repo's rule. ⛔ Every present-tense claim in it must be true of what you actually change; this lane has a card open about changeset prose shipping false into the CHANGELOG.
- ⭐ Bare `Co-authored-by: Claude` trailer **before** the first push. ⛔ No model identifier in any pushed artifact.
- ⛔ Never write a cross-file `path:line` citation into a comment, a doc, or the pull request body — cite by content. ⚠️ On this card that rule bites: the defects are *located* by line number in the card, and ⛔ your prose must not carry those citations forward.
- **Draft** pull request; ⛔ do not flip it ready, enqueue it, or arm auto-merge. The PM seat does the landing.

Report as the structured JSON the seat expects, and ⭐ name loudly any premise above your own measurement falsified.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#9005, and ⭐ the dev is right about the closing keyword; ⛔ the dispatch order was wrong

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), 2026-09-10T17:19Z. Reviewed against the order's own premises on the pull request's diff, ⛔ not on the report's summary of it.

### ⛔ The order's error, corrected in public rather than absorbed

The dispatch order said to write `Fixes objectui#8629`. **That is not a form GitHub parses as a closing reference** — a bare `owner-repo#NNNN` styling is prose. The dev used `Fixes #8629 (objectui#8629)`, declared the deviation, and pointed at the landed precedent that did the same. ⇒ ⭐ the brief is a prediction in both directions, and this time it was the brief that was wrong. ⚠️ Standing correction for this seat's future orders: same-repo closing keywords take the bare `#NNNN`.

### What the diff does — verified, ⛔ not taken from the report

Three files: the guide, the test that already owns the guide, and an empty-frontmatter changeset. Reading the guide's hunks:

| sentence | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the docs-page population on the `/docs/[[...slug]]` route | a literal count | ⭐ **the count is GONE**, replaced by 「every docs page」 plus a deliberate statement that no count is stated here, plus the directory the site's source config declares and the gate's own gauge line |
| the `skills` scan-root file count | a literal count | ⭐ **gone**, replaced by 「the files that stayed behind were enough」 plus the gate's per-root reading |
| the sweeper's page window | a copied constant | ⭐ **named rather than restated** — the export is pointed at |

⛔ **No numeral was corrected anywhere**, which is the ruling's operative clause and the thing this seat checked first.

⭐ **Premise 4 was honoured exactly.** The third member was *pointed at* rather than deleted, because its value is true today and its very membership in the class depends on objectui#7966's open noun-set ruling. ⇒ it survives either answer, and ⛔ this pull request does not pre-empt a ruling that is not its to make.

### ⭐ The pins are better than the order asked for

The order asked for joined-text reading. The pin does that **and proves its own unit**: it builds a control by searching the page for a phrase that exists in the joined text and in **no single line** — and ⭐ if no such phrase exists any more, the control goes **undefined and says so** rather than passing on a reader that has nothing to prove itself against. That is a non-vacuity guard on the control itself, and ⛔ it is not what was requested.

Each pin is also **two-sided**: it refuses a count written back into its section **and** asserts that the derivation the sentence now points at actually exists — the declared docs directory, the gauge line's format, the exported constant by name. ⇒ a future edit that deletes the pointer reddens too, ⛔ not only one that restores a number.

### ⭐ The exclusion list held

The four neighbouring sentences that declare the commit or window they were measured on are **untouched** — confirmed against the diff, which contains three hunks and none of them theirs. The pins are **section-scoped** for that reason. ⚠️ That was the failure mode most likely to turn this card into its own defect, and it did not happen.

### Out of scope, correctly handled

objectui#9004 filed **bare** (no labels, no assignee) for a fourth stated population that the family's noun pattern misses because it is hyphenated, and which is mirrored a second time outside `content/docs/**`. ⛔ The dev declined to widen the family's pattern unilaterally and recorded the gap in the pin's comment instead — right call: widening it touches every carrier.

⇒ CI wait is running on the head. Landing pipeline from here is this seat's.

⭐ **A/A2 and B are the same edit from both sides.** The point of this card is that the literal **goes away**; a leg that only saw the new sentence arrive would be satisfied by a page that gained a pointer and kept its stale number.

⭐ **C is the leg this pull request has to survive, and it is the only one whose expected value is 「unchanged」.** The card names four neighbouring sentences that are **correct precisely because each declares the commit or window it was measured on**, and warns that rewriting any into a live figure would *create* the defect rather than remove it.
